answer: To curb Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce Proof of Burn, requiring each identity to transfer native currency to a verifiable sable burn address before registering as an active network vertex. This imposes an unrecoverable capital destruction cost on an adversary per counterfeit identity. Across an operational horizon, however, this mechanism prices out resource-constrained honest agents and fails to deter well-funded attackers whose exploit returns exceed the burned capital.
